content:
sam: Heads-up — ACME follow-up call at 10am PT tomorrow. They sent a list of asks we should confirm beforehand: per-tenant KMS envelope proof, RBAC least-privilege mapping by role, audit log forwarding options + retention, and IR SLOs. Can we bullet what we can ship by EOD?

jess: I can take KMS envelope proof and rotation window. Quick answers: we support customer-managed keys (BYOK) for Private + Dedicated, envelope encryption at rest, and KMS rotation can be on customer schedule or our managed 30/90 day default.

mira: For evidence we usually provide: architecture diagram, KMS key lifecycle doc, rotation logs (signed), and a sample key policy. Are they expecting HSM attestation (e.g., PKCS11/HSM certs)?

sam: They asked for HSM attestation for on-prem HSMs; for cloud KMS they want proof of key separation + access logs.

jess: OK. I can assemble: diagram + key policy snippet + rotation audit extract. Example key policy we show customers:```json
{"Statement": [{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":"service/redwood-inference","Action":"kms:Encrypt"} ] }```

jess: For rotation logs we can export KMS audit events from CloudTrail/AuditLogs. Example query to extract recent rotations:```bash
# GCP example
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="kms_crypto_key" AND protoPayload.methodName:"CryptoKeyVersions.create"' --limit 100 --format json
# AWS example
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=DisableKeyRotation --max-results 50
```

tom: I'll own RBAC mapping. We have the following roles we can show: `platform_admin`, `infra_operator`, `model_deployer`, `security_viewer`, `support_readonly`. For least-privilege we can map actions per role and show example IAM policies.

mira: Two quick asks from sec review side: 1) can we provide proof that audit logs are immutable for N days (S3 object lock / retention)? 2) can logs be forwarded to customer SIEM in near real-time?

jess: Answer: yes to forwarding — we support pushing via syslog connector, HTTPS webhook, or cross-account CloudWatch/Cloud Logging export. Latency typically <30s for streaming export. For immutability we can show S3 Object Lock configuration or GCS retention; for Hosted we keep 90 days by default but enterprise can request longer retention add-on.

sam: They also asked about RBAC change audit trails and who can approve role changes. What's current workflow?

tom: Role changes require two approvals for `platform_admin` via ticketing + 1-of-2 approvers for infra roles. We log all role changes to audit log with actor, timestamp, and prior state. Example log line:```text
2026-11-03T14:22:13Z role_change actor=jess target=infra_operator change="grant" request_id=req-12345
```

mira: Good. For incident response timeline they want RTO/RPO and escalation path. We provide: initial ack within 15 min for Sev1, mitigation plan within 1 hour, postmortem within 72 hours initial draft. Escalation: oncall -> eng-sre -> head of infra -> CTO.

sam: Nice. Any blockers to producing a signed evidence bundle? They want a downloadable set (diagram + key policy + rotation logs + role mapping + manifest).

jess: I need a tiny script to export rotation events + sign with our upload key. I can produce a gzipped bundle and a SHA256 manifest signed by our key. Example manifest step:```bash
sha256sum evidence.tar.gz > evidence.sha256
# sign with our key (kms-sign example)
aws kms sign --key-id alias/redwood-evidence --message fileb://evidence.sha256 --output text --query Signature | base64 --decode > evidence.sig
```

mira: We should scrub any tenant PII before packaging. Also redact IPs in logs that are customer-facing per contract.

sam: Noted. Tom, can you produce RBAC mapping + sample policies by EOD? Jess please prep evidence bundle skeleton. Mira will handle redaction rules. I'll consolidate and reply to ACME today.

tom: Yep, will push a draft to the thread in ~3 hours.

ops-bot: deploy/api-docs/build #342 succeeded on infra-docs (tag: release/2026-11-02) :white_check_mark:

jess: Uploaded initial skeleton to Google Drive: https://drive.redwood.dev/s/abc123 (private) — includes diagram + key policy + export script. Need someone to review the redaction list.

mira: Reviewing now. Quick redaction rule: mask IPs except customer-owned CIDRs, remove session tokens, and strip user emails when present in logs.

sam: Perfect — I'll update ACME with our list and confirm the call agenda. Thanks team, great turnaround :thumbsup:
